description: This file defines a custom sharding operation for the embedding_bag function in PyTorch, managing distributed computation across multiple GPUs with support for different sharding strategies (row-wise and col-wise). It includes validation, input processing, and sharding-specific handling for embedding bag operations in distributed training.

methods.name: _validate_embedding_bag_param(args, kwargs)
methods.description: Validates the parameters for the sharded embedding_bag operation, ensuring correct types and value constraints, and supporting only ChunkShardingSpec with a single shard.

methods.name: _handle_col_wise_sharding( input, world_size, weight, local_shard, offsets, per_sample_weights, mode, max_norm, norm_type, padding_idx, pg, )
methods.description: Handles the logic for col-wise sharding of the embedding_bag tensor, including gathering inputs, optional max_norm normalization, and performing distributed embedding bag operation.

methods.name: _handle_row_wise_sharding( input, world_size, weight, local_shard, offsets, per_sample_weights, mode, max_norm, norm_type, padding_idx, rank, pg, )
methods.description: Handles the logic for row-wise sharding of the embedding_bag tensor, including input gathering, masking, max_norm normalization, and distributed embedding computations.

methods.name: _all_gather_embedding_bag_input(input, per_sample_weights, offsets, pg)
methods.description: Gathers input tensors, per-sample weights, and offsets across distributed processes for embedding bag operations.
